# Anthropic News — captured 2026-06-10

## June 9, 2026 — Claude Fable 5 and Claude Mythos 5 (NEW since prior scan — NEW MODEL CLASS)
Anthropic launched **Claude Fable 5**, its first publicly available **Mythos-class** model — state-of-the-art on nearly all benchmarks (software engineering, knowledge work, vision, scientific research). Conservative safeguards cause ~<5% of sessions to fall back to Claude Opus 4.8 on high-risk topics.
**Claude Mythos 5** = same underlying model with safeguards lifted in some areas; deployed to a small group of cyberdefenders/infrastructure providers via **Project Glasswing** (US gov collaboration). "Strongest cybersecurity capabilities of any model in the world."
Pricing: $10/M input, $50/M output. Also available on **AWS Bedrock** (Anthropic Claude Fable 5 on AWS, Mythos-class capabilities).
New model IDs (fable-5 / mythos-5) → new AISPM inventory entities + AIRT attack surface. (Reported 2026-06-10 — AIRT HIGH.)
URL: https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-fable-5-mythos-5
